# Emergency Straw Protocol

> A forkable concept seed for emergency food exchange: daily consumer allocation expires; accepted exchange crystallizes into non-expiring producer credit.

Status: interactive single-browser simulation, not a deployed payment system.
License: MIT. Originator: kentaroid-bot. Dialogue: Gemini. Implementation: Codex.

- README.md: English overview, running instructions, architecture, trade-offs.
- DESIGN.md: Japanese intent, dialogue attribution, model and next experiments.
- protocol.json: machine-readable scope and state transitions.
- index.html: Japanese interactive demo; open locally with model.js beside it.
- model.js: dependency-free in-memory model.
- model.test.js: node --test model.test.js.

Phantom signing, Solana transactions, BLE/QR transport, cryptographic verification,
paper redemption and distributed settlement are proposed future work, NOT implemented.
No wallet connection, real assets or real-user information are needed to run the demo.
